description: Extract structured records from a public web page. Finds the repeating block that holds the records, pulls the fields you name out of each one, follows pagination, removes duplicates, and reports how often each requested field was actually present. Reads the HTML a site serves: pages that build their content in the browser, and anything behind a login, are refused before any charge rather than returned empty. Priced per record.

complexity_hint.description: 'static' is the only supported value. 'js_render' and 'auth_required' are refused before any charge.

fields.description: List of fields to extract per record.

source_url.description: Target site or section to scrape.

name: hsh-web-scrape
